poc_results_block_13020932.conclusion: attacker PnL strictly negative in every composition-fee path; loss ~= protocolShare * compositionFee (25%); no unprivileged admin path

H-O.desc: LB composition-fee over-mint (upstream joe-v2 v2.2.0 pre-fix). Minter recovers the LP portion of the composition fee via over-minted shares; effective cost = protocolShare*compositionFee. Bounded per-op by (1-q)*k*(active-bin counterpart reserve) = at most ~$3.40 on the deepest bin (USDT/USDC.e active bin) while attacker pays >= $1.13. Net-positive only via external price deviation > q*k = 0.0125%.
Admin EOAs (0x7F76.../0x0cF8.../0xE9b1...) control LB factory + proxied staking (upgradeable) + OFT owners + V2 fee setters. Key compromise = total loss. Not unprivileged.

MLUM/LUM LayerZero OFT bridge: peers not found for common EIDs; no send traffic since 2026-08; value tiny (~$1.5k MLUM circulating at $0.005). Remote-chain compromise could mint MLUM; not reachable from IOTA EVM by an unprivileged actor.

No MagicSea incident/exploit found in web search
